description: Manage tracked Nasdaq stocks in the local stock manager, then explore daily forward ranks and explicitly labeled retrospective views here. Newly tracked names appear after the next market cycle. Candidates are research labels, not trade recommendations or automatic orders.

links.title: Manage tracked stocks
links.tooltip: Add stocks to the collector and discovery profile

panels.description: Use the Ticker filter above to focus the rank table and charts. New stocks are ranked after the next market cycle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT market_session, rank, ticker, sector, candidate, score::double precision AS score, (return_3m * 100)::double precision AS return_3m_pct, (return_6m * 100)::double precision AS return_6m_pct, (return_12m * 100)::double precision AS return_12m_pct, realized_volatility_1m::double precision AS volatility_1m, (max_drawdown_1m * 100)::double precision AS drawdown_1m_pct, eligibility_status FROM discovery_latest_rankings WHERE ticker ~ '${ticker:regex}' ORDER BY rank NULLS LAST, ticker

panels.title: Latest discovery index

panels.description: Daily score history makes rank stability and deterioration visible. It is not filled across missing discovery sessions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT index.decision_at AS time, ranking.ticker AS metric, ranking.score::double precision AS value FROM discovery_indexes index JOIN discovery_rankings ranking USING (discovery_id) WHERE ranking.eligibility_status = 'eligible' AND ranking.ticker ~ '${ticker:regex}' AND $__timeFilter(index.decision_at) ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Discovery score history

panels.description: Retained daily candidates. Repeated appearances indicate ranking persistence; they do not imply an order or position.

targets.rawSql: SELECT index.market_session, index.decision_at, ranking.rank, ranking.ticker, ranking.score::double precision AS score FROM discovery_indexes index JOIN discovery_rankings ranking USING (discovery_id) WHERE ranking.candidate AND ranking.ticker ~ '${ticker:regex}' ORDER BY index.market_session DESC, ranking.rank

panels.title: Candidate history

panels.description: Current-vintage historical reconstruction using a captured universe snapshot. Earlier dates can predate the snapshot admission.

options.content: **Retrospective reconstruction — hindsight.** Prices use the current Yahoo vintage; original conservative receipt timestamps are retained. Each run applies its captured universe membership snapshot across the reconstructed dates, including dates before that snapshot’s admission. These rows do not represent what was knowable at each past close, and candidates are research labels only.

panels.title: Retrospective data note

panels.description: The most recent operational market session that was successfully registered. This shows the actual published date without assuming a daily run is expected on weekends or exchange holidays.

targets.rawSql: SELECT market_session AS latest_forward_market_session, decision_at AS decision_clock FROM discovery_indexes WHERE model_name = 'momentum-risk-rank' AND model_version = '1.0.0' AND universe_id = '51efed8d-2106-5ac7-b12a-a66cfe0eb097'::uuid ORDER BY market_session DESC, decision_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latest operational session published

panels.description: Explicitly separate hindsight rankings reconstructed from the current Yahoo vintage and the current universe snapshot. Original conservative receipt timestamps are retained; these are not contemporaneous point-in-time ranks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT observation_mode, universe_basis, membership_as_of, reconstructed_at, input_fitness, market_session, rank, ticker, sector, candidate, score::double precision AS score, (return_3m * 100)::double precision AS return_3m_pct, (return_6m * 100)::double precision AS return_6m_pct, (return_12m * 100)::double precision AS return_12m_pct, realized_volatility_1m::double precision AS volatility_1m, (max_drawdown_1m * 100)::double precision AS drawdown_1m_pct, eligibility_status FROM discovery_backfill_latest_rankings WHERE observation_mode = 'retrospective_current_universe' ORDER BY rank NULLS LAST, ticker

panels.title: Retrospective latest ranks — hindsight

panels.description: Score history by historical market session from the separate retrospective store. The series is explicitly hindsight and uses current universe membership.

targets.rawSql: SELECT market_session::timestamp AS time, ticker || ' · hindsight' AS metric, score::double precision AS value FROM discovery_backfill_rankings_history WHERE observation_mode = 'retrospective_current_universe' AND eligibility_status = 'eligible' AND $__timeFilter(market_session) ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Retrospective score history — hindsight

panels.description: Historical closes from the current Yahoo vintage, plotted by market session. Original conservative receipt timestamps remain in the source data; this chart is hindsight, not a point-in-time record.

targets.rawSql: SELECT market_session::timestamp AS time, ticker || ' · current vintage · hindsight' AS metric, close_value::double precision AS value FROM discovery_backfill_prices_history WHERE $__timeFilter(market_session) ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Retrospective Yahoo closes — current vintage, hindsight

list.definition: SELECT ticker AS __text, ticker AS __value FROM (SELECT ticker FROM discovery_latest_rankings UNION SELECT ticker FROM discovery_backfill_latest_rankings WHERE observation_mode = 'retrospective_current_universe') AS tracked ORDER BY ticker
